assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Tender/client source intake and Proposal are distinct business entities.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Proposal acceptance does not itself create Contract execution.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Document evidence is observed before any verified assertion is projected.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Contract, explicit Project Activation, and ServiceEngagement remain distinct.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Contract existence is not Project Activation.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Mobilization work is governed by party, assignment, and authorization boundaries.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Engineering delivery produces design and technical work products.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Professional registration is distinct from a project permit and from approval of a project baseline.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Upload, review, professional approval, and authority approval are separate states.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: AuthorityCase, Package, precheck, submission, findings, and external approval are distinct.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Package ready is not submit authorized, externally submitted, or externally approved.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Final government submission remains a protected human authority.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Construction and post-approval work are linked to an approved design baseline.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Shop drawing, shop drawing submittal, and authority submission of a drawing are distinct families.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Material technical data is not equivalent to a material submittal.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Completion and As-Built records are distinct from Handover.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Completion does not close the independent handover or closeout axes.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: An immutable approved snapshot is distinct from a current working revision.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Employee handover and project handover are separate concepts.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Service scope closure is distinct from contract administrative closure.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Contract Admin, Regulatory, Financial, and Archive closeout axes remain independently represented.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Invoice acceptance, invoice issuance, invoice delivery, payment evidence, and financial settlement are distinct.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Personal payment identifiers are not an AMEC corporate account authority.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Payment verified is not financial settlement.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Master Content has exactly FORM, REPORT, ENGINEERING_WORK, and DEFINITION libraries.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Checklist is a FORM; a template is not a project execution artifact.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: Master Content dependencies are controlled content references, not verified project facts.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: REPORTS is a truth domain for report definitions, dependencies, and outputs.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: REPORT content type is distinct from the REPORTS truth domain.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

assertions.canonical_value_or_rule: A report definition is not a report output.
assertions.notes: Sanitized semantic rule; not a source-document transcription.

continuity_links: M1 -> M2 via Proposal -> Contract -> explicit Project Activation
M4 -> M5 via external confirmation or approval -> Construction
M5 -> M6 via Construction -> Completion or AsBuilt
M6 -> M7 via Completion or AsBuilt -> Handover
M7 -> FINANCE via billing and independent financial closeout
MASTER_CONTENT -> all domains via typed controlled content dependencies
REPORTS -> all domains via report definitions, dependencies, and outputs
